kit.sidebar.title: Places
ask.approve-with-passkey: Approving asks for your passkey, which also opens this wallet, and never a second time. Nothing else is asked of you, unless what you approve can only be read with your seat's keys: then this wallet shows it here and asks you to confirm it before anything is signed. If a check it makes fails or warns, it says why here.
ask.passkey-again: Nothing was sent. Use the button above to try your passkey again, or Decline.
ask.who.origin: This page actually came from {origin}. Your browser told this wallet that, not the request.
ask.who.purpose: Why they say they want it: {purpose}
ask.wallet.opens: Opens {wallet}, the wallet that answers this page.
ask.wallet.choose-why: This browser holds {count} wallets. The one you choose answers this page from now on, and only its passkey is asked for.
ask.wallet.gone-title: The wallet that signed in here is not in this browser
ask.wallet.gone: The wallet that last signed in to {origin} from this browser is no longer held here. Choose the wallet to answer with. A company's key is made from the wallet that gives it, so another wallet's key opens nothing the first one saved.
ask.warn.given: You can refuse the next time they ask. Whoever is behind that page keeps everything they have already opened and anything they copied while it was open, and nothing can take back a key.
ask.warn.how-long: Their page holds the key while it is open, and this wallet never stores it. Nothing stops them keeping their own copy, and nothing here could tell. Treat this as given for good.
ask.sign-in.headline: Sign in to {origin}
ask.sign-in.lede: Tells {origin} this wallet's public address and proves you hold it. Anyone on the network can read what is paid to and from that address. Nothing else about you is sent.
ask.sign-in.warn: {origin} will keep a signed statement that you were here, and the address it was signed by. This wallet can stop signing you in to them later. Nothing can take back what has gone.
ask.unlock.headline: Let {origin} open a company's records
ask.unlock.lede: Gives {origin} the key to the records this company keeps for you. Their page can open those records whenever it is open, and this wallet cannot watch it happen. It also lets the page check whether a payslip was paid to one of your wallets; it does not tell the page any of your addresses.
ask.unlock.compare: the person who invited you to this company gave you themselves, and not through this page
ask.keyring.headline: Let {origin} read your companies with the keys saved under the account name it gives
ask.keyring.lede: This wallet opens those keys itself and tells the page which companies on that site you hold a seat on, with the keys that read each one's records - every company you belong to there, not only one. The keys that approve payments, and the key your saved keys open with, stay in this wallet. Whoever runs that page can read those records whenever it is open, and this wallet cannot watch it happen.
ask.keyring.person: The account name the page gives you: {person}. Any page can give any name; this wallet can only show it to you.
ask.keyring.signed-in-as: The page says you signed in to it as {address}. This wallet checks that address is one of its own before it gives anything.
ask.keyring.new-company: The page is setting up a new company, with you as its founding signer. This wallet makes up the company's label itself, makes your seat in it, signs the company's first roster and state with that seat, and keeps the seat in your saved keys. Your seat's keys stay in this wallet; the page gets the label and the signed records. Give this only if you are setting this company up yourself, on this page, now.
ask.creation.retired-title: This wallet no longer signs this
ask.creation.retired: The page sent a company's account it built itself for this wallet to sign. This wallet now builds the account itself when you finish creating the company, so it signs nothing a page built. Nothing has been signed. Reload the page, which then asks this wallet to finish the company.
ask.keyring.founding: The page names the company {name}, with {signer} as its founding signer ({role}). Only the page says this; this wallet signs the company's first roster with these names and cannot check them.
ask.keyring.also-company: This also gives the page the key to the company named below, the one you opened there. With it the page can read that company's records and how much its vaults hold, and work out your payslip key there; it can never spend with it. It is given only if this wallet's own read of the chain shows that account carrying that label. If it does not, your saved keys still open and that key is not given.
ask.balance.headline: Pay into a company vault for {origin}
ask.balance.headline-public: Pay publicly into a company vault for {origin}
ask.balance.reading: Reading what the page sent. Nothing has been paid.
ask.balance.refused-title: This wallet will not pay for this
ask.balance.cannot-read: This wallet could not load what it reads a transaction with. Nothing has been paid.
ask.balance.leaves-why: Worked out from the transaction itself, not from anything the page said. The coins come from this wallet, and only from it.
ask.balance.no-fee: You pay no network fee. The company pays it.
ask.balance.public: The token and the amount above leave your public balance, and anyone reading the chain can see them, your wallet's public address, and the vault they went into.
ask.balance.night-stops-dust: NIGHT that goes into the vault no longer generates DUST for this wallet.
ask.balance.vault: The vault the transaction pays into: {vault}. This wallet cannot check that the vault belongs to that company.
ask.balance.compare: the person at this company who asked you to pay gave you themselves, and not through this page
ask.balance.paid: Once the company sends this transaction, the money is in its vault. Who can move it from there is decided by the company's account and its vault, not by this wallet, and nothing in this wallet can take it back.
ask.committee.headline: Change who holds a company's rules, for {origin}
ask.committee.hand-over: Brings the company's contracts to the committee that holds its account on the chain. No key joins the company this way.
ask.committee.super-admins: Changes who holds the company's contracts to the committee the page sends, every member of which has signed the change.
ask.committee.join: Signs, with your key, that you hold it, as one of the keys this change puts on the company's contracts. Nothing changes until enough of the super admins sign it too.
ask.committee.to: The committee after the change, as the page sends it: {count} keys, {threshold} of which must sign any change to the company's rules. Anyone not on it loses their place.
ask.committee.compare: the person who invited you to this company gave you themselves, and not through this page
ask.records-key.headline: Sign your records key for a company, for {origin}
ask.records-key.lede: Signs that your records key belongs to this company, for the seat you hold on its account. It names only the company, your records key and your seat, and cannot be used to change any of the company's rules.
ask.records-key.seat: Your seat, as the page names it: {seat}
ask.records-key.directory: In the same answer, your entry in the company's list of who files its records, signed with the key the page names: {key}
ask.records-key.compare-press: Approve only if the fingerprint matches. If this wallet has not kept an account for this company yet, approving keeps this one as the company's for good, and this wallet will sign for no other.
ask.records-key.compare: the person who invited you gave you themselves, by a call, a message or in person, and not through this page
ask.creation.headline: Finish creating a company, for {origin}
ask.join-code.headline: Make a code to join a company, for {origin}
ask.join-code.compare: the person adding you sees for the company, read out to you by a call, a message or in person, and not through this page
ask.addresses.headline: Show {origin} your wallet's private address and balances
ask.addresses.lede: The page sees this wallet's private address and balances, and nothing about your other wallets. Nothing is signed, and nothing can be paid with this. The page can keep what it sees. The page already has your public address from your sign-in, and anyone can read public amounts on the network.
ask.addresses.public-record: Every payment to your public address and its amount is on a record anyone can read.
ask.disclosure.headline: Share your details with {origin}
ask.join.headline: Accept the invitation from {origin}
ask.disclosure.lede: They ask for the details below. Your passkey opens this wallet; you then choose what is sent, and nothing leaves until you press Send.
ask.join.sealed: What you send is sealed on this device to this key before it leaves, and only whoever holds it can open it: {key}. This wallet cannot check the key belongs to the company you think you are joining.
ask.join-code.lede-signer: Signs a code saying that the keys for a seat on this company, as the page names them, are yours. Only their public halves are in the code; their secrets stay on the device that made them.
ask.join-code.lede-payee: Signs a code saying that you are paid at {address}, and that your payslips are sealed to the key this wallet gives for this company. Only these are in the code.
ask.join-code.person: You, as the page signed you in: {person}
ask.keyring.compare: the person who invited you to this company gave you themselves, and not through this page
ask.company-title: The company, as the page names it
ask.swapped-title: This is not the request you approved
ask.swapped: After your passkey, {origin} sent a different request from the one you approved in the window before it. It has been refused: nothing was signed, given or paid. If you meant to do something else, start it again from the page.
ask.committee.check: After your passkey, this wallet reads who holds each contract from the chain and shows you every key this change adds and removes. Nothing is signed until you press Sign this change there.
ask.passkey.none-here: {wallet} has no passkey kept in this browser, so no passkey was asked for: any passkey could have answered and opened another wallet. Nothing was opened and nothing was sent. Choose another wallet below, or open your wallet in a tab of its own, make a new passkey for it there or recover it from its pieces, then ask again from the page.
ask.passkey.other-wallet: That passkey opens another wallet held in this browser, not {wallet}. Nothing was opened and nothing was sent. Choose the wallet to answer with below, then use its passkey.
ask.balance.which-account: It is paid from the account of this wallet that this page has used before, or else from one no site has been given. Which one is kept in this wallet's sealed record, so it is named once your passkey opens the wallet. If another site also has that account's address, or no unused account is left, the payment waits there for you to choose.
ask.over.title: This request is finished
ask.over.lede: The page has had its answer, and nothing more will be asked in this window.
ask.over.framed: The page around this wallet will carry on from here.
ask.act.headline: Run an action for {origin}
ask.act.lede: After your passkey, this wallet runs the steps below from start to end. It builds every transaction itself, from what it reads on the network, and hands each one to the page to send. You can stop it at any step.
ask.act.not-run: This wallet does not run the action the page asked for, so nothing has been shown and nothing has been signed.
ask.act.not-run-title: This wallet will not run this
ask.act.reading: Reading what this action acts on. Nothing has been signed.
ask.act.unread-title: This wallet could not read what this action acts on
ask.act.unread: So it cannot show you, and it will not run it. Nothing has been signed. Try again from the page.
ask.act.from-the-page: {line} Only the page says this; this wallet cannot check it.
ask.act.steps-why: {count} steps, in this order. Each transaction is built by this wallet and handed to the page to send.
ask.act.checks-title: What this wallet checks after your passkey
ask.act.checks-why: If any of these does not hold, nothing is built and nothing is sent.
ask.act.sent: Each transaction already sent, by the page or by this wallet, is out of this wallet's hands. Stopping starts nothing more; it cannot take back one already sent.
ask.act.compare: the person who runs this company with you gave you themselves, and not through this page
act.running.title: Step {step} of {steps}
act.running.lede: Keep this window open. This wallet builds each step's transactions and hands them to the page to send, or sends them itself when they do not go through our service. Nothing more is asked of you, unless this wallet reads with your seat's keys what you are approving: then it shows it here, and sends nothing until you confirm.
act.relayed: Transactions the page confirmed it handed over so far: {count}
act.stop-why: Stop starts no further step and hands nothing more to the page. It cannot take back what has already gone.
act.confirm.title: Check what you are approving
act.confirm.lede: Step {step} of {steps} of the same action. This wallet read what follows with your seat's own keys, from the company's records, not from the page. Nothing has been approved, signed or sent to the network yet. Confirming is a press of the button below, not another passkey, and what is shown here is exactly what you agree to when you press it. If you wait too long, this window stops the action by itself and sends nothing.
act.confirm.stop-why: Stop signs nothing and sends nothing.
act.stopping: Stopping. A transaction already with the page is waited for, so this wallet can say what became of it.
act.over.done: All {steps} steps ran. Transactions the page confirmed it handed over: {relayed}.
act.over.relayed: Transactions the page confirmed it handed over: {relayed}. Stopping cannot take them back.
act.over.continue: Nothing more runs now, and what was done stays done. When you press again on the page, this wallet starts again from the first step and reads the network to work out what is already done. Your passkey is asked for again then.
act.over.locked: This wallet has locked itself again: the keys your passkey opened for this action are no longer held here.
act.why.relay-refused: The page says it did not send a transaction this wallet handed it.
act.why.no-relay-answer: The page did not say in time what it did with a transaction this wallet handed it.
act.why.out-of-time: It ran out of the time this action may take.
act.why.too-many: It would have needed more steps or transactions than any action may take.
act.why.check-failed: This wallet stopped before it sent any transaction itself or handed one to the page to send.
act.why.step-failed: A step did not finish. What earlier steps did stays done.
act.why.keys-did-not-open: The saved keys the page handed this wallet did not open with its key for you, so nothing was changed.
act.why.older-keys: The page handed this wallet a copy of your saved keys that is not the newest one this device has opened, so nothing was opened or changed. Reload the page and try again. If it happens again after a reload, the service holds an older copy of your saved keys: use the device where your saved keys were last changed, or ask whoever runs the service to restore the newest copy.
act.why.keep-refused: The page says your saved keys, as this wallet changed them, were not kept.
act.why.no-keep-answer: The page did not say in time whether your saved keys, as this wallet changed them, were kept.
act.why.call-refused: The page would not pass on a request this action needed, so the action stopped here. What earlier steps did stays done.
act.why.no-call-answer: The page did not say in time what our service answered, so the action stopped here. If this step was sending something, it may still have been sent.
act.over.refused-sent: This wallet stopped at this step, after the page confirmed it handed over transactions for this action. They cannot be taken back.
act.over.refused-maybe-sent: This wallet stopped at this step, and a transaction it sent itself or handed the page may still reach the network.
act.over.check-threw: This wallet could not finish its checks, so it built nothing. Try again from the page.
act.over.unconfirmed_one: One transaction this wallet sent itself or handed the page is not confirmed sent, and it may still reach the network. Wait a few minutes before you do anything more on the page, so that if it was sent, the network shows it.
act.over.unconfirmed_other: {count} transactions this wallet sent itself or handed the page are not confirmed sent, and they may still reach the network. Wait a few minutes before you do anything more on the page, so that whatever was sent shows on the network.
act.over.locked-cut-off: This wallet has locked itself again. A step that had not finished when the action ended can no longer reach your keys or hand anything to the page, but it may still be finishing work it had started; close this window to end it.
act.finish-company.headline: Finish creating your company, for {origin}
act.finish-company.shown.company: The company: the one with the label {label}.
act.finish-company.shown.company-check: This wallet checks after your passkey that it made up this label itself.
act.finish-company.shown.what: This wallet builds your company's account, has the page send it, finishes it, writes down in the company's records the proposal that commits it to the company's pay-record key, and commits it with your seat's approval and your sealed copy of the key.
act.finish-company.shown.transactions: Every transaction is built and proved by this wallet from its own read of the network: the account with its second step, either one again if it ran out before it landed, and the three steps of the pay-record key.
act.finish-company.shown.nothing-else: Your seat's keys stay in this wallet. The page is handed the transactions, the proposal's record sealed under the company's key and signed by your seat, and your saved keys sealed again, nothing else.
act.finish-company.check.drawn: This wallet made up the company's label itself, or kept the company's account as one it created.
act.finish-company.check.seat: The company's founding seat is yours, made again by this wallet from your words.
act.finish-company.check.state: The company's first state is signed by that seat and holds the pay-record key the account is committed to.
act.finish-company.check.deploy: The account starts exactly as its own constructor makes it, held by your key for this company alone.
act.finish-company.check.chain: Where the account stands is read by this wallet from the network itself, never from the page or our servers.
act.finish-company.step.send: Build the company's account and have it sent
act.finish-company.step.finish: Finish the account once the network shows it
act.finish-company.step.propose: Propose committing the account to the pay-record key, with the proposal written down
act.finish-company.step.approve: Approve that proposal with your seat
act.finish-company.step.seal: Seal your copy of the pay-record key
act.finish-company.why.not-a-label: The page did not name a company's label, so nothing was built.
act.finish-company.why.no-record: This wallet's record of the companies it started is not open, so nothing was built. Close this window and try again from the page.
act.finish-company.why.no-saved-keys: The page did not hand this wallet your saved keys, which keep the company being created, so nothing was built. Reload the page and try again.
act.finish-company.why.no-creation: Your saved keys keep no company being created with this label, so nothing was built. It may already be finished: reload the page.
act.finish-company.why.not-drawn-here: This wallet did not make up this company's label, or kept its account as a company someone else created, so it does not finish it. Nothing was built.
act.finish-company.why.pinned-without-de: This wallet kept an account as this company's that your saved keys do not hold, so it builds nothing over it. Use the device where the company was started, or start the company again from the page.
act.finish-company.why.not-your-key: The company kept in your saved keys is held by another key than this wallet's for it, so nothing was built.
act.finish-company.why.not-your-seat: The company kept in your saved keys was founded with another seat than the one this wallet makes from your words, so nothing was built.
act.finish-company.why.state-not-signed: The company's first state kept in your saved keys is not signed by your founding seat, or does not open with it, so nothing was built.
act.finish-company.why.no-pay-record-key: The company's first state holds no pay-record key, so nothing was built.
act.finish-company.why.not-built-with-ke: This wallet was built without the company account's compiled keys, so it cannot build the account. Nothing was built.
act.finish-company.why.carried-elsewhere: Built again, the account would be another one than the company's, so nothing was sent.
act.finish-company.why.deploy-not-as-mad: The account this wallet built does not start as its constructor makes it, so nothing was sent.
act.finish-company.why.not-sent: The company's account was not sent yet, so this step cannot run. Carry on from the page.
act.finish-company.why.not-on-the-chain: The network does not show the company's account, so nothing was built. Carry on from the page once it does.
act.finish-company.over.not-written-down: Your company's pay-record key was proposed before, and its proposal was not written down in the company's records just now: {says} This wallet still went on to approve it and seal your copy of the key as far as the network allowed. Other signers may not see it listed until it is written down.
act.finish-company.why.not-written-down: The proposal committing the account to the pay-record key was not written down in the company's records, so it was not raised: {says} Carry on from the page to try again.
act.finish-company.why.counted-waiting: The network already counts your seat's approval of committing the account to the pay-record key, so nothing was approved again and nothing was sent. The other signers approve it from their own accounts; carry on from the page once they have.
act.finish-company.why.other-pay-record-: The company's account is committed to another pay-record key than the one it was founded with, so nothing was sealed.
act.finish-company.why.clock-behind: This device's clock is {minutes} minutes behind the network's. This wallet built the steps by the network's clock, but the step was not taken: set this device's clock right, then press again on the page.
act.finish-company.why.clock-ahead: This device's clock is {minutes} minutes ahead of the network's. This wallet built the steps by the network's clock, but the step was not taken: set this device's clock right, then press again on the page.
act.claim-by-address.headline: Claim your place at a company by the public address you were added with, for {origin}
act.claim-by-address.shown.company: The company: the one with the label {label}.
act.claim-by-address.shown.address: The address you were added with: {address}. This wallet goes on only if it holds that public address.
act.claim-by-address.shown.proof: This wallet opens your invitation itself. It signs one claim with the key of the address you were added with, for this company, your record and your payslip key. It also signs a code that says where you are paid and which payslip key is yours.
act.claim-by-address.shown.nothing-else: The address's keys stay in this wallet. The page is handed your signed claim and your code, sealed to the inbox key your invitation names, nothing else. Each device of the company checks the claim's signature before you are paid.
act.claim-by-address.check.offer: The invitation opens with your link, names the company and account the page named and your record by this address, and has not expired.
act.claim-by-address.check.held: The address the company added you with is a public address this wallet holds.
act.claim-by-address.check.signed: Your claim is signed by that address's key, for this company, your record and your payslip key alone.
act.claim-by-address.step.claim: Sign your claim and hand it to the company
act.claim-by-address.why.not-a-company: The page did not name a company and an invitation this wallet can read, so nothing was signed. Open the invitation link again.
act.claim-by-address.why.not-a-payee: This invitation does not offer pay, so it is not claimed this way. Nothing was signed. Ask the person who added you to send the invitation for a place on the payroll.
act.claim-by-address.why.not-an-invitati: The page did not name the invitation you are claiming by, so nothing was signed. Open the invitation link again.
act.claim-by-address.why.not-held: The address you were added with is not a public address this wallet holds, so nothing was signed. Open the invitation with the wallet that holds it, or ask the person who added you to check the address.
act.claim-by-address.why.no-payslip-key: This wallet could not work out your payslip key for this company, so nothing was signed. Reload the page and try again. If it stops again, tell the person who added you.
act.claim-by-address.why.no-offer: This wallet could not open the invitation with the link it was given, so nothing was signed. Open the invitation link again.
act.claim-by-address.why.expired: This invitation has expired, so nothing was signed. Ask the person who added you for a new one.
act.claim-by-address.why.another-company: This invitation is for another company or record than the one the page named, so nothing was signed. Open the link you were sent for this company.
act.claim-by-address.why.not-by-address: This invitation was not made by the address the page named, so this wallet does not claim it this way. Accept it with the invitation link.
act.claim-by-address.why.private: You were added by a private address. No device can check a claim of one, so you accept with the invitation link and read out the check code your wallet shows. Nothing was signed.
act.claim-by-address.why.not-signed: This wallet could not sign your claim: {says}. Nothing was handed over.
act.claim-by-address.why.not-taken: The company did not take your claim: {says}. Your keys stayed in this wallet.
act.claim-by-address.why.no-saved-keys: The page did not hand this wallet your saved keys, where the companies that pay you are listed, so nothing was signed. Reload the page and try again.
act.claim-by-address.why.used: This invitation has already been accepted, so nothing was signed or handed over again. If you accepted it with this wallet, the company is already listed among those that pay you. If you did not, tell the person who added you now.
act.join-by-code.headline: Join a company as a payee, for {origin}
act.join-by-code.shown.company: The company: the one with the label {label}.
act.join-by-code.shown.address: Where you are paid: the private address you were invited by, if there is one, which this wallet goes on with only if it holds it; otherwise a private address of this wallet.
act.join-by-code.shown.code: This wallet opens your invitation itself. It signs one code that says where you are paid and which payslip key is yours for this company, and lists the company among those that pay you.
act.join-by-code.shown.fingerprint: When it is done, this window shows a fingerprint of your code. Read it to the person who invited you, by a call, a message or in person, and not through the page.
act.join-by-code.shown.nothing-else: Your keys stay in this wallet. The page is handed your code sealed to the inbox key your invitation names, nothing else.
act.join-by-code.check.offer: The invitation opens with your link, names the company and account the page named, is for pay, and has not expired. It does not prove who made it: the person who invited you checks the fingerprint you read them.
act.join-by-code.check.held: The address you are paid at is a private address this wallet holds.
act.join-by-code.check.listed: The company is listed among those that pay you before your code is handed over.
act.join-by-code.step.join: Sign your code and hand it to the company
act.join-by-code.over.fingerprint: You are paid at {address}. Read this fingerprint to the person who invited you: {fingerprint}
act.join-by-code.why.not-a-company: The page did not name a company and an invitation this wallet can read, so nothing was signed. Open the invitation link again.
act.join-by-code.why.not-an-invitation: The page did not name the invitation you are joining by, so nothing was signed. Open the invitation link again.
act.join-by-code.why.no-saved-keys: The page did not hand this wallet your saved keys, where the companies that pay you are listed, so nothing was signed. Reload the page and try again.
act.join-by-code.why.no-offer: This wallet could not open the invitation with the link it was given, so nothing was signed. Open the invitation link again.
act.join-by-code.why.used: This invitation has already been accepted, so nothing was signed or handed over again. If you accepted it with this wallet, the company is already listed among those that pay you. If you did not, tell the person who invited you now.
act.join-by-code.why.used-by-this-wallet: This invitation has already been accepted, so nothing was handed over again. This wallet made a code for it before: you are paid at {address}; read this fingerprint to the person who invited you: {fingerprint}. If it does not match the one they see, nobody is admitted. If you did not accept it, tell them now.
act.join-by-code.why.expired: This invitation has expired, so nothing was signed. Ask the person who invited you for a new one.
act.join-by-code.why.another-company: This invitation is for another company or record than the one the page named, so nothing was signed. Open the link you were sent for this company.
act.join-by-code.why.not-a-payee: This invitation does not offer pay, so you do not join this way. Nothing was signed.
act.join-by-code.why.by-public-address: You were invited by a public address, so you claim your place with that address's own signature, with no code to read out. Nothing was signed.
act.join-by-code.why.not-held: You were invited by a private address this wallet does not hold, so nothing was signed. Open the invitation with the wallet that holds it, or ask the person who invited you to check the address.
act.join-by-code.why.no-address: This wallet could not work out a private address to be paid at, so nothing was signed. Reload the page and try again.
act.join-by-code.why.no-payslip-key: This wallet could not work out your payslip key for this company, so nothing was signed. Reload the page and try again. If it stops again, tell the person who invited you.
act.join-by-code.why.not-signed: This wallet could not sign your code: {says}. Nothing was handed over.
act.join-by-code.why.not-taken: The company did not take your code: {says}. Your keys stayed in this wallet. If it took your code after all, you are paid at {address}; read this fingerprint to the person who invited you: {fingerprint}. If it does not match the one they see, nobody is admitted.
act.seat-invited.headline: Take the seat you were invited to by your address, for {origin}

act.seat-invited.check.offer: The invitation is this company's, offers a seat by address, and has not expired.
act.seat-invited.check.address: The address it offers the seat to is one this wallet holds.
act.seat-invited.check.chain: The network takes the seat only for the proposal the company's signers approved for that address.

act.seat-invited.why.not-a-company: The page did not name a company and an invitation this wallet can read, so nothing was proved or sent. Open the invitation link again.
act.seat-invited.why.no-offer: This wallet could not open the invitation with the link it was given, so nothing was proved or sent. Open the invitation link again.
act.seat-invited.why.withdrawn: The company took this invitation back, so nothing was proved or sent. Ask the person who invited you for a new one.
act.seat-invited.why.withdrawn-kept: The company took this invitation back, after this wallet had kept a seat for it. If that seat was already taken on the network, this invitation cannot add you to the company. Tell the person who invited you. Nothing more was proved or sent.
act.seat-invited.why.used: Another request already answered this invitation, so nothing was proved or sent. Ask the person who invited you for a new one.
act.seat-invited.why.expired: This invitation has expired, so nothing was proved or sent. Ask the person who invited you for a new one.
act.seat-invited.why.another-company: This invitation is for another company than the one the page named, so nothing was proved or sent. Open the link you were sent for this company.
act.seat-invited.why.not-by-address: This invitation does not offer a seat by address, so this wallet does not take it this way. Accept it with the invitation link.
act.seat-invited.why.not-held: The address this seat was offered to is not a private address this wallet holds, so nothing was proved or sent. Open the invitation with the wallet that holds it.
act.seat-invited.why.no-free-seat: This wallet has used every seat it can take on this company, so nothing was proved or sent. Tell the signer who invited you.
act.seat-invited.why.taken-by-another: The network shows this invitation's seat already taken by another wallet, so nothing was sent. Ask the signer who invited you for a new invitation.
act.seat-invited.why.not-on-chain: This wallet could not read the company's account on the network, so nothing was proved or sent. Try again in a minute.
act.seat-invited.why.not-built: This wallet could not prove your seat: {says}. Nothing was sent.
act.seat-invited.why.may-be-sent: Your seat may have been taken: {says}.
act.seat-invited.why.no-saved-keys: The page did not hand this wallet your saved keys, so your seat could not be kept. Your seat is taken on the network; reload the page and try again to ask to be admitted.
act.seat-invited.why.not-asked: Your seat is taken on the network and kept in your saved keys, and the company did not take your request to be admitted: {says}. Open the invitation link again to ask again.
act.seat-invited.why.already-seated: This wallet already holds a seat on this company, so it does not take a second one. Nothing was proved or sent. If you were invited by mistake, tell the signer who invited you.
act.seat-invited.why.no-slots: This wallet could not check the network for a seat it can take on this company, so nothing was sent. Try again in a minute.
act.seat-invited.why.no-keys-to-keep: The page did not hand this wallet your saved keys, so your seat would have nowhere to be kept. Nothing was proved or sent. Reload the page and try again.
act.seat-invited.why.threshold-above-the: This invitation sets the approvals the company needs to {threshold} once your seat is taken, and the company would then have only {seats} signers, so the network would refuse it. act.invite.shown.title: Their title: {title}.
act.invite.shown.address: The address they are invited at: {address}.
act.invite.shown.amount: Their pay: {amount} in the smallest unit of {asset}.
act.invite.shown.terms-amount: Each month: {amount} in the smallest unit of {asset}.
act.invite.shown.every-vault: Their seat may act on every vault, as yours does.
act.invite.shown.scope: Their seat carries the rights {scope}, which this wallet offers only when they are the rights of your own seat or yours covers every vault.
act.invite.shown.threshold: Once their seat is taken, the company needs {threshold} approvals for a change to the company's account. The signers who approve the seat approve this number with it, and the network sets it when the seat is taken.
act.invite.shown.signer-checks: This wallet invites a signer only at a private address. act.invite.shown.kept: Before anything is raised, the invitation is kept in your saved keys, so an attempt stopped part way is taken up again with no second proposal.
act.invite.shown.raise: It raises the proposal to seat that address with your seat's approval. The signers approve it up to the company's threshold, and the person takes the seat from their own wallet.
act.invite.shown.sealed: The details above are sealed under the company's key and signed by your seat before they are filed. The service sees the kind of invitation and a random record id, never a name, an amount or an address.
act.invite.shown.nothing-else: Your seat's keys stay in this wallet. The page gets back only where the invitation got to, and makes the link from its own token.
act.invite.check.seat: Your seat is one this company's account holds on the network now, and its role may invite.
act.invite.check.sealed: The invitation, the offer and the first record are sealed and signed in this wallet.
act.invite.check.signer: A signer is invited at a private address that is not yours, held by no seat or open invitation here, with rights no wider than your seat's.
act.invite.step.seat: Read the company and your seat
act.invite.why.not-a-company: The page did not name a company this wallet can read, by its record, its label and its account, so nothing was signed.
act.invite.why.no-saved-keys: The page did not hand this wallet your saved keys, which hold your seat, so nothing was signed. Reload the page and try again.
act.invite.why.no-seat: Your saved keys hold no seat on this company, so nothing was signed. Open the company on the device where you took your seat.
act.invite.why.seat-not-held: The seat your saved keys hold is not one this company's account holds on the network now, so nothing was signed. If you have just been seated, wait a minute and try again.
act.invite.why.not-on-chain: This company has no account on the network yet, so nothing was signed. Finish creating the company first.
act.invite.why.roster-not-opened: This wallet could not open the company's list of signers with your seat, so nothing was signed. Reload the page and try again.
act.invite.why.not-a-token: The page did not give a whole token for the invitation's link, so nothing was signed. Reload the page and try again.
act.invite.why.no-name: The invitation names nobody, so nothing was signed. Give the person's name.
act.invite.why.not-an-asset: The invitation's pay is in a currency this wallet does not know, so nothing was signed.
act.invite.why.no-pay: The invitation's pay is not above nothing, so nothing was signed. Give the pay in the currency's smallest unit.
act.invite.why.no-classification: An employee is invited full-time or part-time, and this invitation says neither, so nothing was signed.
act.invite.why.no-start: The invitation gives no start date, so nothing was signed.
act.invite.why.no-terms: A vendor is invited with how they are paid, one-off or monthly, and this invitation says neither, so nothing was signed.
act.invite.why.no-role: A signer is invited with a role, and this invitation names none this wallet knows, so nothing was signed.
act.invite.why.signer-by-address: A signer is invited only at their private address, and this invitation gives none, so nothing was signed. Ask them for their private address.
act.invite.why.super-admin: A super admin is invited by the company's super admins, never by a seat, so nothing was signed.
act.invite.why.not-a-kind: The invitation is not for an employee, a vendor or a signer, so nothing was signed.
act.invite.why.no-opening: Your saved keys do not keep how your seat was made, so the person invited could not check your seat, and nothing was signed. Take your seat again on this device's wallet.
act.invite.why.own-address: That private address is one this wallet holds, and one wallet holds one seat, so nothing was signed. Ask the person for their own address.
act.invite.why.wider-scope: The rights offered are wider than your own seat's, so nothing was signed. Offer the rights your seat holds, or ask a signer whose seat covers every vault.
act.invite.why.not-a-threshold: The approvals needed once the seat is taken are not a whole number of at least one, so nothing was signed. Leave it out to keep the number in force.
act.invite.why.filed-not-entered: The invitation was filed, and its record was not entered in the company's records ({says}), so no other device believes it yet. Do not start a new invitation: press again to carry on with this same one, and the wallet enters its record then.
act.invite.why.offer-not-read: This wallet could not read whether an invitation is already filed under this link (the service answered {status}), so nothing was signed or sent. The page keeps the same link: press again in a minute to carry on with this same invitation.
act.invite.why.not-filed: The company did not file the invitation: {says} Nothing was raised.
act.invite.why.raised-not-filed: The proposal to seat this address was raised, and the invitation was not filed. The page keeps its link: press again to file it, or give the link to the person yourself. What was said: {says}
act.invite.why.may-be-sent: The invitation stopped after part of it was handed over to be sent: {says} Do not invite this person again: press again to carry on with this same invitation.

act.approve-proposal.shown.name: Who is invited: {name}.
act.approve-proposal.shown.role.admin: Their role as a signer: admin.

act.approve-proposal.shown.role.viewer: Their role as a signer: viewer.
act.approve-proposal.shown.address: The address they are invited at, as the proposal commits to it: {address}.
act.approve-proposal.shown.coin-key: The coin key of that address, which only its own wallet can prove: {coinKey}.
act.approve-proposal.shown.every-vault: Their seat may act on every vault.
act.approve-proposal.shown.new-threshold: Once their seat is taken, the company needs {threshold} approvals for a change to the company's account: the network sets it when they take the seat.
act.approve-proposal.shown.checks: This wallet opens the proposal itself and approves it only when it invites exactly the person, role, address, rights, approvals needed once the seat is taken and coin key above, the coin key makes that address, and no seat made by an invitation and no other open invitation already holds that address. act.approve-proposal.shown.approve: It adds your seat's approval to the proposal the network already holds, and raises nothing. Once the approvals reach the company's bar, the person takes the seat from their own wallet.
act.approve-proposal.shown.nothing-else: Your seat's keys stay in this wallet. The page gets back only where the proposal got to and how many approvals the network shows.
act.approve-proposal.check.seat: Your seat is one this company's account holds on the network now.
act.approve-proposal.check.same: The proposal invites exactly the person, role, address, rights and coin key shown, and the coin key makes that address.
act.approve-proposal.check.one-seat: No seat made by an invitation and no other open invitation holds that address, so it would not approve twice, except for the founding seat's address, which no device can tell.

act.approve-proposal.step.seat-and-confi: Read the company, your seat and what you approve, and show it to you to confirm
act.approve-proposal.step.approve: Check the proposal and approve it
act.approve-proposal.why.not-a-proposal: The page did not name the company, the proposal and what it invites, with a role a signer may hold, so nothing was approved.
act.approve-proposal.why.not-a-threshold: The approvals needed once the seat is taken, as the page named them, are not a whole number of at least one, so nothing was approved.
act.approve-proposal.why.not-a-company: The page did not name a company this wallet can read, by its record, its label and its account, so nothing was approved.
act.approve-proposal.why.no-saved-keys: The page did not hand this wallet your saved keys, which hold your seat, so nothing was approved. Reload the page and try again.
act.approve-proposal.why.no-seat: Your saved keys hold no seat on this company, so nothing was approved. Open the company on the device where you took your seat.
act.approve-proposal.why.seat-not-held: The seat your saved keys hold is not one this company's account holds on the network now, so nothing was approved. If you have just been seated, wait a minute and try again.
act.approve-proposal.why.not-on-chain: This company has no account on the network yet, so nothing was approved.
act.approve-proposal.why.roster-not-open: This wallet could not open the company's list of signers with your seat, so nothing was approved. Reload the page and try again.
act.approve-proposal.why.already-counted: The network already counts your approval of this proposal, so nothing was approved again and nothing was sent. The other signers give the rest of the approvals from their own accounts; once the person takes the seat from their own wallet, press Finish adding on the Signers page.
act.approve-proposal.why.carried-out: This proposal already has its approvals and the network has carried it out: the person has taken the seat. There is nothing left to approve, and nothing was sent. Press Finish adding beside their name on the Signers page to admit them.
act.approve-proposal.why.withdrawn: The proposal was withdrawn while your approval was being sent. Your approval was sent, and the proposal is closed, so there is nothing more to approve.
act.approve-proposal.why.may-be-sent: The approval stopped after it was handed over to be sent: {says} Press again: an approval the network already counts is not sent twice.
act.approve-proposal.check.chain: Where the proposal stands, its approvals and the approvals it needs are read from the network through this wallet, never from the company's service.
act.approve-proposal.why.outrun: A signer was removed or replaced since this proposal was raised, so the network will never carry it out. Nothing was approved, and nothing was sent. Withdraw it and raise it again.
act.approve-policy.shown.proposal: The proposal, as the company's records name it: {proposal}.
act.approve-policy.shown.policy-vault: It sets the spending policy of vault {vault}, for the currency the proposal commits to.
act.approve-policy.shown.read-here: After your passkey, this wallet reads the policy's terms itself, from the company's records, with your seat's own key: the page does not name them. It shows them to you in this window as it read them, and sends nothing until you confirm them; then it approves exactly those. A proposal whose policy it cannot open is not approved.
act.approve-policy.shown.policy: It sets the spending policy of vault {vault} for the currency {token}.
act.approve-policy.shown.band: Band {n}: a run whose total fits no earlier band and is at most {ceiling} {symbol} needs {approvals} approvals.
act.approve-policy.shown.limit: The vault pays at most {limit} {symbol} ({name}) in each period of {days} days, the first starting {start}.
act.approve-policy.shown.period-starts-a: Carrying it out starts this period's total again: the vault may pay up to {limit} {symbol} more in the period now running, whatever it has already paid in it.
act.approve-policy.shown.confirm-period-: You confirm that once this change is carried out, the vault's total for the period now running starts again at nothing.
act.approve-policy.shown.raises-the-seat: Carrying it out raises the approvals any change to a spending policy, and adding or removing a signer, need to at least {approvals}. If {approvals} is every signer the company seats, one lost key leaves the runs in that band unable to be paid, and no signer can be added or removed after that.
act.approve-policy.shown.checks: This wallet opens the policy the proposal commits to from the company's records, and approves exactly the terms it read and showed you. It checks that the vault keeps enough signers who may approve its runs at every band of the policies in force, and that no signer whose removal is raised filed it, and checks again before everything it sends.
act.approve-policy.shown.bar: Any change to a spending policy, adding, removing or re-seating a signer, and raising a vault's approvals past {bar}, need {bar} approvals from now on, or the company's threshold where that is higher.
act.approve-policy.shown.bar-every-signe: If {bar} is every signer the company seats, one lost key leaves no signer able to be added or removed and no spending policy able to change, from then on.
act.approve-policy.shown.bar-below-a-ban: This may be fewer than a band of a policy in force asks for; the next policy set raises it again to its highest band.
act.approve-policy.shown.checks-bar: This wallet opens the proposal from the company's records and approves it only if it sets exactly this number, no more than the signers the company's account seats. It checks again before everything it sends.
act.approve-policy.shown.approve: It adds your seat's approval to the proposal the network already holds, raises nothing and writes no record. Once the network counts the approvals it needs, this wallet carries it out.
act.approve-policy.step.carry: Carry the change out once it has its approvals
act.approve-policy.why.cannot-show: The policy this proposal sets cannot be shown in this window, so nothing was approved and nothing was sent.
act.approve-policy.why.not-read: This wallet has not read the policy this proposal sets, so nothing was approved. Nothing was sent.
act.approve-policy.why.not-a-policy: The page did not name the vault the policy is for, so nothing was approved.
act.approve-policy.why.not-a-bar: The page did not name a whole number of approvals, at least one, so nothing was approved.
act.approve-policy.why.not-a-known-curre: The policy is for a currency this wallet does not know, so it cannot show its amounts as money, and nothing was approved.
act.approve-policy.why.not-a-company: The page did not name a company this wallet can read, by its record, its label and its account, so nothing was approved.
act.approve-policy.why.not-raised: The network holds no proposal raised for this change, so nothing was approved, and nothing was sent.
act.approve-policy.why.not-carried: The change has its approvals and was not carried out: {says} Press again to carry it out.
act.approve-policy.why.may-be-sent: The change stopped after it was handed over to be sent: {says} Press again: what the network already holds is not sent twice.
act.approve-policy.why.not-as-shown: The proposal under that name does not change what the page showed, so nothing was approved and nothing was sent. Reload the page.
act.approve-policy.why.withdrawn: The proposal was withdrawn, so there is nothing to approve or carry out.
act.approve-policy.why.carried-out: The network has already carried this change out, so there is nothing left to approve, and nothing was sent.
act.approve-policy.why.already-counted: The network already counts your approval of this change, so nothing was approved again and nothing was sent.
act.approve-policy.why.outrun: A signer was removed or replaced since this proposal was raised, so the network will never carry it out. Nothing was sent. Withdraw it and raise it again.
act.approve-start.shown.adopt: It adopts the vault {vault} into the company, as the page names it: once adopted, the company's signers hold it, and every payment from it and change to it needs their approvals.
act.approve-start.shown.checks-adopt: This wallet opens the proposal from the company's records and approves it only if it is the adoption of exactly this vault, as this wallet makes it from the vault itself. It checks that every vault keeps enough signers who may approve its runs, and that no signer whose removal is raised filed it, and checks again before everything it sends.
act.approve-start.shown.secret: It sets the first secret of the vault {vault}, as the page names it: the vault keeps and pays its money privately under it, and takes no money until it is set.
act.approve-start.shown.sealed-to: The vault's secret is sealed only to the {seats} seats the company's account holds on the network now, as this wallet read it: after your passkey this wallet checks that its keys are exactly those seats', each signed by that signer's own wallet and matched to the company's list of signers; if one cannot be believed, nothing is approved.
act.approve-start.shown.sealed-to-unread: This wallet could not read the company's account on the network yet. After your passkey it reads it again, and approves the secret only if it is sealed to exactly the seats the account holds, each one's key signed by that signer's own wallet.
act.approve-start.shown.readers: The signers who will hold the vault's secret, as the page names them. These names are the page's word; this wallet checks the keys, not the names: {names}.
act.approve-start.shown.checks-secret: This wallet opens the vault's secret from the company's records, and approves only the run it makes from that secret itself. It checks that the vault holds no other secret, that every seat the account holds can open its sealed copy and that yours opens with your keys, and that no signer whose removal is raised filed it, and checks again before everything it sends.
act.approve-start.shown.carry-secret: Once the network counts the approvals it needs, this wallet sets the secret on the vault and writes each signer's sealed copy of it, one transaction each.
act.approve-start.shown.approve: It adds your seat's approval to the proposal the network already holds, raises nothing and files no record. Once the network counts the approvals it needs, this wallet carries it out, and writes the proposal down as carried out once the network shows it done.
act.approve-start.step.carry: Carry it out once it has its approvals
act.approve-start.why.not-a-vault: The page did not name a vault this wallet can read as one, so nothing was approved.
act.approve-start.why.not-raised: The network holds no proposal raised for this, so nothing was approved, and nothing was sent.
act.approve-start.why.not-carried: It has its approvals and was not carried out: {says} Press again to carry it out.
act.approve-start.why.may-be-sent: It stopped after something was handed over to be sent: {says} Press again: what the network already holds is not sent twice.

act.approve-start.why.carried-out: The network has already carried this out, so there is nothing left to approve, and nothing was sent.
act.approve-start.why.already-counted: The network already counts your approval of this, so nothing was approved again and nothing was sent.
act.approve-start.why.outrun: A signer was removed or replaced after this vault's adoption was raised, so the network will never carry it out, and this wallet neither withdraws it nor raises it again. Nothing was approved, and nothing was sent. The vault holds nothing: create a new vault instead.
act.approve-pay-key.shown.proposal: It commits the company's account to its pay-record key, by the proposal {proposal} as the page names it. Until the key is committed, the company is not finished.
act.approve-pay-key.shown.checks: This wallet opens the proposal from the company's records and approves it only if a seat of this company wrote it down and it commits the account to exactly the pay-record key the company's signed first state holds, as this wallet works the proposal out from that key itself. act.approve-pay-key.shown.approve: It adds your seat's approval to the proposal the network already holds, raises nothing and files no record. act.approve-pay-key.step.carry: Commit the key once it has its approvals
act.approve-pay-key.why.not-a-pay-key: The company's records hold no proposal under that name that this wallet can open as the one committing the account to its pay-record key, so nothing was approved and nothing was sent. Reload the page.
act.approve-pay-key.why.not-as-held: The proposal under that name does not commit the account to the pay-record key the company's signed first state holds, so nothing was approved and nothing was sent. Do not approve it.
act.approve-pay-key.why.not-raised: The network holds no proposal raised for this, so nothing was approved, and nothing was sent.
act.approve-pay-key.why.not-carried: It has its approvals and was not carried out: {says} Press again to carry it out.
act.approve-pay-key.why.may-be-sent: It stopped after something was handed over to be sent: {says} Press again: what the network already holds is not sent twice.
act.approve-pay-key.why.withdrawn: The proposal was withdrawn on the network, so there is nothing to approve or carry out.
act.approve-pay-key.why.carried-out: The network has already committed the account to its pay-record key, so there is nothing left to approve, and nothing was sent.
act.approve-pay-key.why.already-counted: The network already counts your approval of this, so nothing was approved again and nothing was sent.
act.approve-pay-key.why.outrun: A signer was removed or replaced after this proposal was raised, so the network will never carry it out. Nothing was approved, and nothing was sent.

act.change-threshold.shown.threshold: The approvals the company's account needs become {threshold}.
act.change-threshold.shown.vault-thresho: The approvals the runs of vault {vault} need become {threshold}.
act.change-threshold.shown.raises-the-se: If {threshold} is more than the approvals adding or removing a signer needs now, carrying this out raises that to {threshold} as well.
act.change-threshold.shown.every-signer-: If {threshold} is every signer the company seats, one lost key leaves this vault unable to pay, and no signer can be added or removed after that.
act.change-threshold.shown.every-signer: If {threshold} is every signer the company seats, one lost key leaves the company unable to approve any change or any payment that needs its threshold, and no signer can be added or removed after that.
act.change-threshold.shown.checks: This wallet checks, from the network and the company's records, that the network would carry this change out and that every vault keeps enough signers who may approve its runs, and checks again before everything it sends.
act.change-threshold.shown.raise: It raises the change as a proposal with your seat's approval, or approves the same change already raised. Once the network counts the approvals it needs, this wallet carries it out.
act.change-threshold.shown.approve: It adds your seat's approval to the proposal the network already holds, and raises nothing. Once the network counts the approvals it needs, this wallet carries it out.
act.change-threshold.shown.nothing-else: Your seat's keys stay in this wallet. The page gets back only where the proposal got to and how many approvals the network shows.
act.change-threshold.check.seat: Your seat is one this company's account holds on the network now.

act.remove-signer.shown.proposal: The proposal, as the company's records name it: {proposal}.
act.remove-signer.shown.leaf: The seat removed, as the company's account holds it: {leaf}.
act.remove-signer.shown.keeps-the-thresh: The approvals the company's account needs stay as they are.
act.remove-signer.shown.threshold: Once they are removed, the approvals the company's account needs become {threshold}.
act.remove-signer.shown.retirement: Your seat signs the leaving signer's retirement in the company's records. The network is asked to carry the removal out only once enough signers have signed that retirement and it is filed and anchored.
act.remove-signer.shown.checks: This wallet checks, from the network and the company's records, that the network would carry this removal out and that every vault keeps enough signers who may approve its runs, and checks again before everything it sends.
act.remove-signer.shown.raise: It raises the removal as a proposal with your seat's approval, or approves the same removal already raised. Once the network counts the approvals it needs, this wallet carries it out, then changes the company's key where your seat may.
act.remove-signer.shown.named-here: After your passkey, this wallet names whose seat this is from the company's list of signers as it opens it, never from the page, and sends nothing until you confirm it. It approves the removal only of a seat that list holds.
act.remove-signer.confirm.removing: This removal takes {name}'s seat ({leaf}) off the company, as the company's list of signers this wallet opened names it. If that is not the signer you mean to remove, press Stop: nothing is approved, raised or sent, and tell the company's other signers.
act.remove-signer.shown.approve: It adds your seat's approval to the removal the network already holds, and raises nothing. Once the network counts the approvals it needs, this wallet carries it out, then changes the company's key where your seat may.
act.remove-signer.shown.nothing-else: Your seat's keys stay in this wallet. The page gets back only where the removal got to and how many approvals the network shows.
act.remove-signer.check.seat: Your seat is one this company's account holds on the network now.
act.remove-signer.check.chain: The seat removed is one the account holds, and the signers left are at least the approvals the account will need and the approvals a policy change needs.
act.remove-signer.check.vaults: No vault is left worse off than now with fewer signers who may approve its runs than its threshold needs, counting one more for each signer removed since an open run was raised. The approvals a spending policy's bands ask for are not counted.
act.remove-signer.step.seat: Read the company, your seat and whose seat this removal takes, and show it to you to confirm
act.remove-signer.step.raise: Check the removal and raise it
act.remove-signer.step.carry: Carry the removal out once it has its approvals
act.remove-signer.over.continue: Nothing more runs now, and what was done stays done. Pressing again on the page finds the removal this window raised, and raises nothing twice.
act.remove-signer.over.removing: You approved taking {name}'s seat ({leaf}) off the company, as the company's list of signers this wallet opened names it. If that is not the signer you meant to remove, tell the company's other signers now, before it has the approvals it needs: the signer who raised it can still withdraw it.
act.remove-signer.why.not-a-company: The page did not name a company this wallet can read, by its record, its label and its account, so nothing was sent.
act.remove-signer.why.not-a-removal: The page did not name a seat to remove, or named a number of approvals that is not a whole number, so nothing was sent.
act.remove-signer.why.no-saved-keys: The page did not hand this wallet your saved keys, which hold your seat, so nothing was sent. Reload the page and try again.
act.remove-signer.why.no-seat: Your saved keys hold no seat on this company, so nothing was sent. Open the company on the device where you took your seat.
act.remove-signer.why.seat-not-held: The seat your saved keys hold is not one this company's account holds on the network now, so nothing was sent.
act.remove-signer.why.not-on-chain: This company has no account on the network yet, so nothing was sent.
act.remove-signer.why.roster-not-opened: This wallet could not open the company's list of signers with your seat, so nothing was sent. Reload the page and try again.
act.remove-signer.why.not-carried: The removal has its approvals and was not carried out: {says} Press again to carry it out.
act.remove-signer.why.may-be-sent: The removal stopped after something was handed over to be sent: {says} Press again: what the network already holds is not sent twice.
act.remove-signer.why.not-as-shown: The proposal under that name does not remove the seat the page showed at the approvals it showed, so nothing was approved and nothing was sent. Reload the page.
act.remove-signer.why.not-read: This wallet has not read whose seat this removal takes, so nothing was approved. Nothing was sent.
act.remove-signer.why.not-read-to-raise: This wallet has not read whose seat this removal takes, so nothing was raised. Nothing was sent.
act.remove-signer.why.no-such-seat-to-ra: The company's list of signers, as this wallet opened it, holds no seat {leaf}, so it cannot say whom this removal would take off. Nothing was raised and nothing was sent. Reload the page.
act.remove-signer.why.no-such-seat: The company's list of signers, as this wallet opened it, holds no seat {leaf}, so it cannot say whom this removal takes off. Nothing was approved and nothing was sent. Do not approve it: reload the page, and if it happens again, tell the company's other signers.
act.remove-signer.why.withdrawn: The removal was withdrawn, so there is nothing to approve or carry out.
act.remove-signer.why.carried-out: The network has already carried this removal out, so there is nothing left to approve, and nothing was sent.
act.remove-signer.why.already-counted: The network already counts your approval of this removal, so nothing was approved again and nothing was sent.
act.remove-signer.why.waits-for-the-rota: Removing a signer waits until this wallet also replaces the vault secrets the leaving signer holds. Nothing was sent.
act.remove-signer.why.outrun: A signer was removed or replaced since this removal was raised, so the network will never carry it out. Nothing was sent. Withdraw it and raise it again.
act.raise-run.headline: Raise a payroll run from your company's vault, for {origin}
act.raise-run.shown.total-raw: What it pays in all: {total} of the currency {token}, which this wallet does not know
act.raise-run.shown.private: The payments are made privately: the network does not show the addresses paid or the amounts. It does show that payments leave this vault, so anyone can count how many payments the vault has made; anyone who has seen the vault's earlier payments can still work out a payee from what was spent and what came back as change; and on a vault with a spending policy the approvals the run needs show which band its total falls in.
act.raise-run.shown.public: The payments are public. A public payment puts the address, the amount and the currency on a record anyone can read.
act.raise-run.shown.window: It may be paid from {opensAt} until {closesAt}. Until it opens, a signer can withdraw it; once it opens, nobody can.
act.raise-run.shown.retry: This is a retry: it pays again only the people of the run named above whose payment did not go through.
act.raise-run.shown.public-again: A retry's payments are public, as the run's first payments were: each one made puts the address, the amount and the currency on a record anyone can read.
act.raise-run.shown.draw: No run is named, so after your passkey this wallet draws the run for that month over the company's people as it reads them, and shows you who it pays and what in all before anything is filed or raised. Press Confirm to file it sealed under the company's key, so the service keeps no name, amount or address of it in the clear, and raise it; Stop ends with nothing filed or raised.
act.raise-run.shown.matched: After your passkey this wallet opens the run, which it cannot read before, and raises nothing unless it is the run, and pays exactly the list, month, people, total, vault and window, shown above.
act.raise-run.shown.raise: It checks the run against the company's records and the vault's money, private and public, on this device, then proposes it on the network. The other signers approve it from their own accounts.
act.raise-run.shown.nothing-else: Nothing else is signed or sent.
act.raise-run.check.seat: The seat your saved keys hold is one the company's account holds on the network now.
act.raise-run.check.run: The run is the one shown: its name, who it pays, the month, the people, the total, the vault and, for a proposal sent again, its window.
act.raise-run.check.window: The run's payment window is given, and opens after now.
act.raise-run.check.vault: The vault holds enough to pay it, as this device reads the vault's records and the network.
act.raise-run.step.seat: Read your seat and the company
act.raise-run.step.seat-and-confirm: Read your seat and the company, draw the run and ask you to confirm it
act.raise-run.confirm.drawn: This wallet drew the run {run} from the company's records as it reads them. Nothing of it is filed or raised yet.
act.raise-run.confirm.token-public: It pays in {symbol}, publicly: each payment puts the address and the amount on a record anyone can read.
act.raise-run.confirm.token-raw-private: It pays privately in the currency {token}, which this wallet does not know.
act.raise-run.confirm.token-raw-public: It pays publicly in the currency {token}, which this wallet does not know: each payment puts the address and the amount on a record anyone can read.
act.raise-run.confirm.total-raw: What it pays in all: {total} of the currency {token}
act.raise-run.confirm.others: The run also pays {others} more people in another currency or form. They are filed with it and raised on their own, not by this Confirm.
act.raise-run.confirm.set-aside: {name} is set aside and not paid on this run ({why}).
act.raise-run.confirm.window: It may be paid from {opensAt} until {closesAt}. Until it opens, you can withdraw it; once it opens, nobody can.
act.raise-run.confirm.ask: Confirm files this run sealed under the company's key and raises it for the vault above. Stop ends here: nothing is filed, raised or sent.
act.raise-run.step.raise: Open the run and propose it
act.raise-run.why.not-a-company: The page did not name a company this wallet can read, by its record, its label and its account, so nothing was signed or raised. Reload the page and try again.
act.raise-run.why.no-saved-keys: The page did not hand this wallet your saved keys, which hold your seat, so nothing was signed or raised. Reload the page and try again.
act.raise-run.why.no-seat: Your saved keys hold no seat on this company, so nothing was signed or raised. Open the company on the device where you took your seat.
act.raise-run.why.seat-not-held: The seat your saved keys hold is not one this company's account holds on the network now, so nothing was signed or raised. Ask a signer whether your seat was removed or replaced.
act.raise-run.why.not-on-chain: This company has no account on the network yet, so nothing was signed or raised. Finish creating the company, then raise the run.
act.raise-run.why.roster-not-opened: This wallet could not open the company's list of signers with your seat, so nothing was signed or raised. Reload the page and try again.
act.raise-run.why.not-a-run: This is not a run this wallet can raise: {says}. Nothing was signed or raised.
act.raise-run.why.no-window: The page gave no payment window for this run, or one that closes before it opens, so nothing was raised. Choose when the run may be paid and raise it again.
act.raise-run.why.window-open: This run's payment window opens at {opensAt}, which is not after now, so nothing was raised: a run whose window has opened can no longer be withdrawn. Choose a window that opens later and raise it again.
act.raise-run.why.not-as-shown: The run this wallet opened is not the one this window showed ({says}), so nothing was raised. Reload the page and look at the run again. If the run was drawn and confirmed in this window, it was filed as a draft and nothing more.
act.raise-run.why.not-raised: The run was not raised: {says}. Nothing was sent to the network.
act.raise-run.why.raise-may-be-sent: The proposal was handed to the page to send, and it did not confirm it went: {says}. Do not raise the same run again: open the company's runs to see whether it arrived.
act.pay-run.headline: Pay an approved payroll run from your company's vault, for {origin}
act.pay-run.shown.proposal: The run's proposal, as the page names it: {proposal}
act.pay-run.shown.total-raw: What it pays in all: {total} of the currency {token}, which this wallet does not know
act.pay-run.shown.private: The payments are made privately: the network does not show the addresses paid or the amounts. It does show that payments left this vault, so anyone can count how many payments the vault has made; anyone who has seen the vault's earlier payments can still work out a payee from what was spent and what came back as change; and on a vault with a spending policy the approvals the run needed show which band its total falls in.
act.pay-run.shown.public: The payments are made publicly. A public payment puts the address, the amount and the currency on a record anyone can read. Every person this run pays is put on it, with what they are paid.
act.pay-run.shown.matched: After your passkey this wallet opens the proposal and its run, which it cannot read before, and pays nothing unless it pays exactly the list, month, people, total and vault shown above, from the vault the proposal itself names.
act.pay-run.shown.pay: It pays nothing unless the network holds the proposal open with the approvals it needs, and its payment window is open now. Then it charges the run to the vault's spending policy period, if the vault has one, and pays each person the network does not yet show paid, one payment each. It approves nothing.
act.pay-run.shown.merge: Where no single note of the vault pays a person, it first merges the vault's notes into one.
act.pay-run.shown.no-merge: This wallet cannot yet merge the vault's notes: if paying a person would need that, it refuses the run before charging it, and nothing is sent.
act.pay-run.shown.again: If it stops part way, it says how many people were paid. Paying the run again pays only the people still owed: the company's account refuses to pay anyone twice for the run.
act.pay-run.shown.nothing-else: The page is handed the charge, the payments and merges to send, the vault's records to file, and the upkeep's above, and nothing else.
act.pay-run.check.seat: The seat your saved keys hold is one the company's account holds on the network now.
act.pay-run.check.run: The run is the one shown: who it pays, the month, the people, the total and the vault, which is the vault its proposal names.
act.pay-run.check.chain: The network holds the run's proposal open, with the approvals it needs.
act.pay-run.check.window: The run's payment window is open now.
act.pay-run.step.seat: Read your seat and the company on the network
act.pay-run.step.check: Open the run and read where its proposal stands
act.pay-run.step.pay: Pay the run from the vault
act.pay-run.why.not-a-company: The page did not name a company this wallet can read, by its record, its label and its account, so nothing was signed or paid. Reload the page and try again.
act.pay-run.why.no-saved-keys: The page did not hand this wallet your saved keys, which hold your seat, so nothing was signed or paid. Reload the page and try again.
act.pay-run.why.no-seat: Your saved keys hold no seat on this company, so nothing was signed or paid. Open the company on the device where you took your seat.
act.pay-run.why.seat-not-held: The seat your saved keys hold is not one this company's account holds on the network now, so nothing was signed or paid. Ask a signer whether your seat was removed or replaced.
act.pay-run.why.not-on-chain: This company has no account on the network yet, so nothing was signed or paid. Finish creating the company first.
act.pay-run.why.roster-not-opened: This wallet could not open the company's list of signers with your seat, so nothing was signed or paid. Reload the page and try again.
act.pay-run.why.not-a-run: This is not a run this wallet can pay: {says}. Nothing was paid.
act.pay-run.why.not-as-shown: The run this wallet opened is not the one this window showed ({says}), so nothing was paid. Do not pay it. Reload the page and look at the run again.
act.pay-run.why.not-raised: The network holds no proposal raised for this run yet, so nothing was paid. Reload the page later.
act.pay-run.why.withdrawn: This run's proposal was withdrawn, so nothing was paid.
act.pay-run.why.closed: The network does not hold this run's proposal open now: its window ended. Nothing was paid. Look at the run's payments before you raise it again.
act.pay-run.why.not-open-yet: This run's payment window opens at {opensAt}, so nothing was paid yet. Pay it again once the window has opened.
act.pay-run.why.window-closed: This run's payment window has closed, so nothing was paid. Raise a retry for the people still owed.
act.pay-run.why.not-payable: The vault cannot pay this run as it stands: {says}. Nothing was charged or paid.
act.pay-run.why.charge-not-seen: The run's charge to the vault's period was sent, and the network has not shown it yet. Nothing was paid. Pay the run again in a few minutes: it is not charged twice.
act.pay-run.why.not-charged: The run was not charged to the vault's period, so nothing was paid: {says}
act.pay-run.why.payment-not-seen: A payment was handed to the page to send, and the network has not shown it yet: {says}. It may still arrive. Paying the run again later pays only the people the network does not show paid.
act.pay-run.why.payment-not-recorded: A payment is on the network, and the vault's record of it is not filed yet: {says}. The next action in this wallet records it; paying the run again does not pay that person again.
act.pay-run.why.not-paid: The run was not paid: {says}. Nothing was sent.
act.pay-run.why.may-be-sent: Something was handed to the page to send, and it did not confirm it went: {says}. Pay the run again later: it pays only the people the network does not show paid, and does not charge the run twice.
act.pay-run.why.stopped-unseen: {paid} of the {payees} people this run pays were paid, and a payment may still be landing: {says}. Do not pay the run again yet: wait a few minutes and open the run again first. Paying it then pays only the people still owed, and nobody twice.
act.pay-run.why.stopped: {paid} of the {payees} people this run pays were paid, and then it stopped: {says}. Pay the run again: it pays only the people still owed, and nobody twice.

act.withdraw-proposal.shown.kind: What the page says it is: {kind}
act.withdraw-proposal.shown.who: After your passkey this wallet opens the proposal from the company's records, and withdraws nothing unless it is of the kind shown. It reads from the network, with your seat, where the proposal stands and who raised it: a payroll run can be withdrawn by any signer until its time to be paid begins; any other proposal only by the signer who raised it. A proposal the network does not hold is only marked withdrawn in the company's records, by the signer who wrote it down: if a raise of it was already sent, it may still arrive, and its raiser can then withdraw it on the network.
act.withdraw-proposal.shown.final: A withdrawal closes the proposal: nobody can approve it or carry it out afterwards. To make the change or the payment, raise it again.
act.withdraw-proposal.shown.nothing-else: Nothing else is signed or sent.
act.withdraw-proposal.check.seat: The seat your saved keys hold is one the company's account holds on the network now.
act.withdraw-proposal.check.same: The proposal is the one shown: its kind as the company's records seal it, and its identity on the network as its own record makes it.
act.withdraw-proposal.check.chain: The network would take the withdrawal: it is a run whose time to be paid has not begun, or a proposal your seat raised; or the network does not hold it and your seat wrote it down.
