act.withdraw-proposal.why.not-a-company: The page did not name a company this wallet can read, by its record, its label and its account, so nothing was signed or withdrawn. Reload the page and try again.
act.withdraw-proposal.why.no-saved-keys: The page did not hand this wallet your saved keys, which hold your seat, so nothing was signed or withdrawn. Reload the page and try again.
act.withdraw-proposal.why.no-seat: Your saved keys hold no seat on this company, so nothing was signed or withdrawn. Open the company on the device where you took your seat.
act.withdraw-proposal.why.seat-not-held: The seat your saved keys hold is not one this company's account holds on the network now, so nothing was signed or withdrawn. Ask a signer whether your seat was removed or replaced.
act.withdraw-proposal.why.not-on-chain: This company has no account on the network yet, so nothing was signed or withdrawn.
act.withdraw-proposal.why.roster-not-ope: This wallet could not open the company's list of signers with your seat, so nothing was signed or withdrawn. Reload the page and try again.
act.withdraw-proposal.why.not-a-proposal: The page did not name the company, the proposal and its kind, or named a kind this wallet does not know, so nothing was signed or withdrawn. Reload the page and try again.
act.withdraw-proposal.why.never-adopt-va: Adding a vault to the company is not withdrawn from this wallet: raised again later it would carry the same identity, and an approval the network already holds for it cannot be given again, so it could never be carried out. act.withdraw-proposal.why.never-vault-se: A vault's first secret is not withdrawn: its time to be paid begins as it is raised, so the network takes no withdrawal of it. Leave it, and finish setting the vault up. Nothing was signed or sent.
act.withdraw-proposal.why.never-pay-key: The company's pay-record key is not withdrawn from this wallet: raised again later it would carry the same identity, and an approval the network already holds for it cannot be given again, so it could never be carried out. Leave it for the signers to approve. Nothing was signed or sent.
act.withdraw-proposal.why.never-recovery: A recovery of the company's records is not withdrawn from this wallet: it is not among the company's proposals this wallet opens. Nothing was signed or sent.
act.withdraw-proposal.why.one-off-held: This one-off payment is on the network, and a one-off is open for payment as soon as it is raised, so the network takes no withdrawal of it. Leave it unapproved: it cannot be paid once its time ends. Nothing was signed or sent.
act.withdraw-proposal.why.not-as-shown: The proposal this wallet opened is not of the kind this window showed, so nothing was withdrawn. Reload the page and look at the proposal again. Nothing was signed or sent.
act.withdraw-proposal.why.closed: The network no longer holds this proposal: it was carried out, withdrawn or closed already, so there is nothing to withdraw. Nothing was signed or sent.
act.withdraw-proposal.why.started: This run's time to be paid has begun, and from then on the network lets nobody withdraw it. It does not have the approvals it was raised needing: leave it unapproved, and it cannot be paid once its time ends. Nothing was signed or sent.
act.withdraw-proposal.why.started-may-be: This run's time to be paid has begun, and from then on the network lets nobody withdraw it. It has the approvals it was raised needing, or this wallet could not read how many it needs, so it may be paid now with no other approval. A signer whose seat may hold runs on its vault can still hold it on the network until it is charged or paid. Nothing was signed or sent.
act.withdraw-proposal.why.started-charge: This run has been charged to its period and can be paid, so the network lets nobody withdraw it or hold it. Nothing was signed or sent.
act.withdraw-proposal.why.clock-ahead: This device's clock is ahead of the network's time. The network would still take this run's withdrawal, but this wallet checks the withdrawal against the device's clock as it builds it, and by that clock the run's time to be paid has begun. Set this device's clock right and try again. Nothing was signed or sent.
act.withdraw-proposal.why.sent-not-yet-s: This proposal was sent to the network and the network does not show it yet, so it may still arrive. Wait until the network shows it, then withdraw it. Nothing was signed or sent.
act.withdraw-proposal.why.filed-by-anoth: Another signer wrote this proposal down and it has not been sent to the network. Only the signer who wrote it down withdraws it before then: ask them. Nothing was signed or sent.
act.withdraw-proposal.why.not-raised-her: This change to the company was raised by another signer, and the network lets only the signer who raised it withdraw it: ask them. Nothing was signed or sent.
act.withdraw-proposal.why.raiser-not-rea: This wallet could not read from the network who raised this proposal, so it cannot tell whether the network would take your withdrawal. Reload the page and try again. Nothing was signed or sent.
act.withdraw-proposal.why.chain-time-not: This wallet could not read the network's time, so it cannot tell whether a run's time to be paid has begun, from when the network lets nobody withdraw it, or whether a raise of a proposal the network does not show may still reach it. act.create-vault.headline: Create a vault for your company, for {origin}
act.create-vault.over.continue: Nothing more runs now, and what was done stays done. If this vault was started, the page offers to finish setting it up, and that carries on from where the network shows it stopped. Create vault itself always starts a new vault.
act.create-vault.shown.company: The company: the one with the label {label}.
act.create-vault.shown.company-check: This wallet checks after your passkey that the network's account carries this label and seats your seat.
act.create-vault.shown.pin: If this wallet has not kept an account for this company yet, it keeps the account the page names, {account}, with the fingerprint {fingerprint}, as the company's for good, once the invitation you joined by checks out against the network. Approve only if that fingerprint matches the one the person who invited you gave you.
act.create-vault.shown.keys: First this wallet gives your vault keys: it signs your records key and your directory entry, files the entry, and offers the company your seat's vault keys.
act.create-vault.shown.new: Then it builds a new vault held by your company's committee from its first transaction, adopts it into the company with your seat's approval, opens its pool, makes the vault's secret itself and sets it.
act.create-vault.shown.carry-on: The vault to carry on setting up, as the page names it: {vault}.
act.create-vault.shown.carry-on-check: This wallet carries it on from where the network shows it stopped, and checks after your passkey that the vault was born held by your company.
act.create-vault.shown.title: The vault's name, as the page gives it: {title}.
act.create-vault.shown.about: The vault's description, as the page gives it, signed by your seat into the vault's name filing: {about}.
act.create-vault.shown.sealed-to: The vault's secret is sealed only to the {seats} seats the company's account holds on the network now, as this wallet read it, each one's key signed by that signer's own wallet; if one cannot be believed, nothing is approved.
act.create-vault.shown.readers: The signers, as the page lists them: {names}.
act.create-vault.shown.nothing-else: Your seat's keys and the vault's secret are made and kept in this wallet. The page is handed the transactions, the filings and your saved keys sealed again. The page holds the vault's secret from the moment this wallet files it: with it the page can read every amount paid into and out of the vault and where each payment out goes, and it can never spend from the vault.
act.create-vault.check.seat: The seat your saved keys hold is one the company's account holds on the network, and the company's list of signers names it.
act.create-vault.check.readers: Every seat the account holds on the network has a records key signed by its own wallet and believed in the company's directory, and the vault's secret is sealed to exactly those.
act.create-vault.check.born-held: The vault was born held by your company's committee and runs this build's circuits, as this wallet reads it on the network.
act.create-vault.check.made-here: The vault's first secret is one this wallet made and kept, or one the network's commitment already names.
act.create-vault.step.entry: Sign your records key and file your entry in the company's directory
act.create-vault.step.offer: Offer the company your vault keys
act.create-vault.step.start: Build the vault, adopt it, open its pool and set its secret

act.create-vault.why.not-on-chain: This company has no account on the network yet, so nothing was signed. Finish creating the company first.

act.create-vault.why.records-key-refused: This wallet did not sign your records key for this seat: {says}
act.create-vault.why.account-not-kept: This wallet could not keep the company's account, so nothing has been kept or signed. Try again.
act.create-vault.why.no-person: The page did not say who is signed in, so your directory entry was not made. Reload the page and try again.
act.create-vault.why.entry-not-filed: Your entry in the company's directory was not filed: {says}. It is kept in your saved keys and filed the next time you press.
act.create-vault.why.no-record: This wallet's record of the companies it keeps is not open, so nothing was signed. Close this window and try again from the page.
act.create-vault.why.not-a-vault: The page named a vault this wallet cannot read as one, so nothing was signed.
act.create-vault.why.readers-refused: The vault's secret was not sealed: {says}
act.company.why.no-account: The network holds no company account at the address the page names, so nothing was signed.
act.company.why.other-label: The account the page names is not this company's on the network, so nothing was signed.
act.company.why.unreadable: This wallet could not read the company's account on the network, so nothing was signed. Try again in a minute.
act.create-vault.shown.sealed-to-unread: This wallet could not read the company's account on the network yet. After your passkey it reads it again, and seals the vault's secret only to the seats it holds, each one's key signed by that signer's own wallet; if one cannot be believed, nothing is approved.
act.private-deposit.headline: Put money into your company's vault privately, for {origin}
act.private-deposit.over.continue: Nothing more runs now, and what was done stays done. Putting money in again from the page makes a new deposit: before you do, press Check my last deposit on the page.
act.private-deposit.shown.amount: The amount, as the page asks for it: {amount} of the private token {token}, counted in that token's smallest unit.
act.private-deposit.shown.pays: This wallet pays exactly that amount into the vault, privately, from the private balance of the account of this wallet that this page has used before, or else of one no site has been given. Which account is named after your passkey; if another site also has its address, or no unused account is left, you choose there. Nothing else leaves this wallet, and you pay no network fee.
act.private-deposit.shown.vault: The vault, as the page names it: {vault}.
act.private-deposit.shown.vault-check: After your passkey this wallet reads the vault on the network and pays nothing unless it is your company's vault and takes money.
act.private-deposit.shown.records: As your seat, this wallet signs and files these records for your company, each with a signed entry in the company's record manifest:
act.private-deposit.shown.journal: a line in the vault's deposit journal naming this coin, filed before the deposit is sent;
act.private-deposit.shown.pool: the vault's record of its money with this coin added, once the network shows the deposit;
act.private-deposit.shown.earlier: the same record with your last deposit into this vault from this wallet, only if the network shows it arrived and it is not in the record yet;
act.private-deposit.shown.secret-again: the vault's secret filed again as its newest, only if the newest filed is not the one the network holds.
act.private-deposit.shown.manifest: Each of these is signed with your seat's key in this wallet and handed to the page to file; the page signs nothing.
act.private-deposit.shown.nothing-else: The page is handed the deposit's one transaction to send, and the upkeep's above. Until the network shows this deposit, or an hour and a quarter has passed, this wallet on this device makes no other deposit into this vault, whatever the page says.
act.private-deposit.check.seat: The seat your saved keys hold is one the company's account holds on the network.
act.private-deposit.check.vault: The vault is your company's on the network and takes money.
act.private-deposit.check.secret: The vault's secret the company's records hold is the one the network holds, so the coin is one your company can name.
act.private-deposit.check.built: What this wallet pays for is exactly the coin it built: the amount and token shown, into this vault.
act.private-deposit.check.one-on-its-way: No earlier deposit this wallet made on this device into this vault can still arrive.
act.private-deposit.step.seat: Read your seat and the company on the network
act.private-deposit.step.deposit: Build, pay, send and record the deposit
act.private-deposit.why.not-a-company: The page did not name a company this wallet can read, by its record, its label and its account, so nothing was paid.
act.private-deposit.why.no-saved-keys: The page did not hand this wallet your saved keys, which hold your seat, so nothing was paid. Reload the page and try again.
act.private-deposit.why.no-seat: Your saved keys hold no seat on this company, so nothing was paid. Open the company on the device where you took your seat.
act.private-deposit.why.seat-not-held: The seat your saved keys hold is not one this company's account holds on the network now, so nothing was paid.
act.private-deposit.why.not-on-chain: This company has no account on the network yet, so nothing was paid.
act.private-deposit.why.roster-not-opene: This wallet could not open the company's list of signers with your seat, so nothing was paid. Reload the page and try again.
act.private-deposit.why.no-person: The page did not say who is signed in, so nothing was paid. Reload the page and try again.
act.private-deposit.why.not-a-vault: The page named a vault this wallet cannot read as one, so nothing was paid.
act.private-deposit.why.nothing: The page asked for a deposit of nothing, or of a token this wallet cannot read, so nothing was paid.
act.private-deposit.why.no-account: No account of this wallet was chosen to pay from, so nothing was paid.
act.private-deposit.why.not-as-built: What this wallet was about to pay for is not the coin it built for the vault shown, so it paid nothing.
act.private-deposit.why.not-yet-seen: The deposit was handed to the page to send, and the network has not shown it yet. It may still arrive, so do not put the same money in again: this wallet on this device makes no other deposit into this vault until the network shows it or an hour and a quarter has passed. The next action you take for this company in this wallet, on this device, records it; you do not need to deposit again for that.
act.private-deposit.why.landed-not-recor: The deposit is in the vault, and this wallet could not yet read the transfer that brought it in, so it is not in the vault's record yet. Do not put the same money in again. The next action you take for this company in this wallet, on this device, records it; you do not need to deposit again for that.
act.one-off-payment.headline: Make a one-off payment from your company's vault, for {origin}
act.one-off-payment.shown.amount: The amount, as the page asks for it: {shown} {symbol} ({name}), which is {amount} of the currency {token} counted in its smallest unit.
act.one-off-payment.shown.amount-raw: The amount, as the page asks for it: {amount} of the currency {token}, counted in that currency's smallest unit. This wallet does not know that currency's name or units.
act.one-off-payment.shown.payee: Paid to the address, as the page gives it: {payee}.
act.one-off-payment.shown.vendor: Paid to a vendor of your company, as the page names their entry: {vendor}. After your passkey this wallet reads that vendor's entry from your company's records, and raises, approves and pays nothing unless the address above is the one their entry pays, at the keys their entry holds.
act.one-off-payment.shown.name: The payee's name, as the page gives it: {name}.
act.one-off-payment.shown.reason: The reason, as the page gives it: {reason}.
act.one-off-payment.shown.vault: Paid out of the vault, as the page names it: {vault}.
act.one-off-payment.shown.private: The address is a private one, so the payment is made privately: the network does not show who is paid, and the amount is not public. It does show that a payment left this vault, so anyone can see that the vault paid and count how many payments it has made. Anyone who has seen the vault's earlier payments can still work out the payee from what was spent and what came back as change, and on a vault with a spending policy the approvals the proposal needs show which band it falls in.
act.one-off-payment.shown.public: The address is a public one, so the payment is made publicly. A public payment puts the address, the amount and the currency on a record anyone can read.
act.one-off-payment.shown.window: This wallet sets the time the payment may be made in: from five minutes before now until a week from now at most, and never past the end of the vault's spending policy period that holds today. Near the end of a period that time is shorter: a payment proposed then must be approved and carried out before the period ends, or proposed again in the next.
act.one-off-payment.shown.record: As your seat, this wallet raises the proposal and files the payment's record, sealed to your company's signers under the company key, each with a signed entry in the company's record manifest. The proposal and the record the company's service is sent carry no amount, payee or name.
act.one-off-payment.shown.carry-out: Once the network shows the approvals the proposal needs, this wallet charges the payment to the vault's spending policy period, if the vault has one, and pays it from the vault, as far as the company's account accepts each. If more approvals are needed, it stops after the proposal: nothing pays on approval alone, so once the others have approved, a signer carries it out by running this action again for this proposal.
act.one-off-payment.shown.proposal: The one-off payment already proposed, as the page names it: {proposal}.
act.one-off-payment.shown.matched: After your passkey this wallet opens the payment's sealed record, which it cannot read before, and approves, charges and pays nothing unless the record is exactly the payment shown above, as the page gave it.
act.one-off-payment.shown.approve: This wallet reads the payment from your company's sealed record of it, checks it is the one the proposal names, and approves it as your seat unless your seat already has.
act.one-off-payment.shown.nothing-else: The page is handed the proposal, the payment's sealed record and its entry to file, any approval, the charge and the payment to send, and the upkeep's above, and nothing else.
act.one-off-payment.check.seat: The seat your saved keys hold is one the company's account holds on the network.
act.one-off-payment.check.payment: The payment is one a one-off can carry: a positive amount, an address on this network in the form the currency is paid in, and a reason.
act.one-off-payment.check.vault: The vault holds enough to pay it, as this device reads the vault's record and the network.
act.one-off-payment.check.policy: The vault's spending policy, read from your company's sealed record and checked against the network, allows it in this period at this many approvals.
act.one-off-payment.check.chain: The payment is charged and paid only when the network shows the approvals the proposal names and the company's account accepts the charge and the payment.
act.one-off-payment.step.seat: Read your seat and the company on the network
act.one-off-payment.step.raise: Propose the payment and file its record
act.one-off-payment.step.approve: Read the proposed payment and approve it
act.one-off-payment.step.charge: Charge the payment to the vault's period
act.one-off-payment.why.not-a-company: The page did not name a company this wallet can read, by its record, its label and its account, so nothing was signed or paid. Reload the page and try again.
act.one-off-payment.why.no-saved-keys: The page did not hand this wallet your saved keys, which hold your seat, so nothing was signed or paid. Reload the page and try again.
act.one-off-payment.why.no-seat: Your saved keys hold no seat on this company, so nothing was signed or paid. Open the company on the device where you took your seat.
act.one-off-payment.why.seat-not-held: The seat your saved keys hold is not one this company's account holds on the network now, so nothing was signed or paid. Ask a signer whether your seat was removed or replaced.
act.one-off-payment.why.not-on-chain: This company has no account on the network yet, so nothing was signed or paid. Finish creating the company, then make the payment.
act.one-off-payment.why.roster-not-opene: This wallet could not open the company's list of signers with your seat, so nothing was signed or paid. Reload the page and try again.
act.one-off-payment.why.no-person: The page did not say who is signed in, so nothing was paid. Reload the page and try again.
act.one-off-payment.why.not-a-vault: The page named a vault this wallet cannot read as one, so nothing was signed or paid. Go back to the page and enter the payment again.
act.one-off-payment.why.not-a-currency: The page named a currency this wallet cannot read as one, so nothing was signed or paid. Go back to the page and enter the payment again.
act.one-off-payment.why.nothing: The page asked for a payment of nothing, so nothing was signed or paid. Go back to the page and enter the payment again.
act.one-off-payment.why.payee: The payee's address is not one this wallet can pay on this network ({says}), so nothing was signed or paid. Check the address with the person you are paying.
act.one-off-payment.why.not-a-payment: {says} Nothing was signed or paid. Go back to the page and enter the payment again.
act.one-off-payment.why.raise-may-be-sen: The proposal was handed to the page to send, and it did not confirm it went: {says}. Do not propose the same payment again: open the company's proposals to see whether it arrived.
act.one-off-payment.why.raise-not-seen: The proposal was sent, and the network has not shown it yet. Do not propose the same payment again: carry it on from the company's proposals once it shows.
act.one-off-payment.why.closed: The network does not hold this proposal open now, so nothing more was sent. It may already have been paid: check the vault's payments before you propose it again.
act.one-off-payment.why.outrun: A signer was removed or replaced since this proposal was raised. Each change needs one more approval, so the payment cannot be carried out yet. Nothing more was sent. Once enough other signers approve it, carry it out again.
act.one-off-payment.why.not-a-one-off: This wallet does not believe the proposal named is one of your company's one-off payments, so nothing was signed or paid. Do not approve it. Tell the signer who proposed it.
act.one-off-payment.why.not-as-shown: The proposal's sealed record is not the payment this window showed ({says}), so nothing was approved, charged or paid. Do not approve it. Tell the signer who proposed it.
act.one-off-payment.why.approval-may-be-: Your approval was handed to the page to send, and it did not confirm it went: {says}. Open the proposal again later to see where it stands.
act.one-off-payment.why.not-charged: The payment was not charged to the vault's period, so it was not paid: {says}
act.one-off-payment.why.charge-may-be-se: The charge was handed to the page to send, and it did not confirm it went: {says}. Nothing was paid. Carry the payment on later: it is not charged twice.
act.one-off-payment.why.charge-not-seen: The charge was sent, and the network has not shown it yet. Nothing was paid. Carry the payment out again in a few minutes: it is not charged twice.
act.one-off-payment.why.payment-not-seen: The payment was handed to the page to send, and the network has not shown it yet: {says}. It may still arrive, so do not pay it again.
act.one-off-payment.why.payment-not-reco: The payment is on the network, and the vault's record of it is not filed yet: {says}. Do not pay it again: the next action in this wallet records it.
act.one-off-payment.why.not-found: This wallet could not find the payment in your company's records: {says}. Nothing more was sent. Try again in a few minutes, once the records and the network have caught up.
act.one-off-payment.over.continue: Nothing more runs now, and what was done stays done. If this window proposed the payment, pressing again on the page proposes a second payment, not this one. If it carried on a payment already proposed, pressing again on that payment reads the network and carries it on from there.
act.one-off-payment.over.awaiting: Proposed. Not paid yet: the payment needs {needed} approvals and has {approvals}. Once the others approve, a signer carries it out.
act.upkeep.step.first: Do first what the company is owed of your seat
act.upkeep.step.last: File each vault's records again, give each vault's secret to the signers who lack it, and anchor the company's records if your seat may
act.upkeep.shown.may: In this same window and under this same passkey, this wallet also does what the company is owed of your seat. It works that out after your passkey from its own reads of the network and of the company's records, never from a list the page keeps:
act.upkeep.shown.entry: your entry in the company's directory, if your saved keys hold one not yet filed;
act.upkeep.shown.rotation: first, a change of the company's key, made and signed by your seat, if a signer's removal left the key to change; the change is anchored at once, which is one more transaction;
act.upkeep.shown.roster: a new version of the company's list of signers, signed by your seat, if no device believes the one filed;
act.upkeep.shown.vaults: each vault's records, filed again by your seat for the signers seated since they were last written, naming any deposit the network shows that they do not name yet;
act.upkeep.shown.secrets: each vault's secret, given by your seat if its role may file vault records, to every other signer the network seats who lacks it: a copy wrapped to the key in that signer's directory entry. A signer whose entry this wallet does not believe yet is given it by a later action;
act.upkeep.shown.anchor: at the end, if your seat's role may anchor, the company's records that are not yet anchored, this action's own among them, anchored on the network with your seat's key: one more transaction. Otherwise a seat that may anchor them does.
act.upkeep.check.worked-out: What the company is owed of your seat is worked out from this wallet's own reads, never from a list the page keeps. What could not be done is said, and the company's next seat action does it.
act.upkeep.why.not-confirmed: This wallet handed the page a transaction for the company's records, and the service did not confirm it sent it, so the action stopped here. What the action did before this step is done, and that transaction may have been sent. Press again later to anchor what is left.
act.upkeep.why.no-person: The page did not say who is signed in, so the vaults' records were not filed again. Reload the page and try again.
